newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia says condensate resources rise 14 pc.
newsitem.headline: Australia says condensate resources rise 14 pc.

text.p: Major gas discoveries off the northwest coast had led to a 14 percent increase in Australia's condensate resources to 1,575 million barrels at the end of calendar 1996, the government said on Friday.
Resources and Energy Minister Warwick Parer said the new reserve estimates were made by the Bureau of Resource Sciences in an annual publication issued this week.
"Recent oil discoveries, also in offshore northwestern Australia, will lead to a substantial increase in oil resources and provide further security for Australia's oil supplies," Parer said.
He said the bureau had also substantially increased its estimate of undiscovered gas resources in the Carnarvon Basin of Western Australia.
He did not provide specific details.
